objective: Accurate client coordination for ISO/IEC 27001 certification-readiness projects

client-intake.expected_when: A client readiness request is available and the project brief is absent or needs a source-backed update.
client-intake.acceptance: The brief separates sourced facts, assumptions, and missing fields.
client-intake.fallback: Reconcile supplied information and list unresolved scope questions.
client-intake.recovery: Refresh current project sources and continue unfinished useful work within the routine scope.

client-input-review.expected_when: A project has not yet had its supplied inputs inventoried for this review period.
client-input-review.acceptance: Every expected category is marked available, partial, or missing with evidence paths.
client-input-review.fallback: Refresh the inventory from the current client-input directory.
client-input-review.recovery: Refresh current project sources and continue unfinished useful work within the routine scope.

client-clarification-draft.expected_when: A current missing-information review contains unresolved client questions.
client-clarification-draft.acceptance: The local draft asks concise questions tied to identified gaps.
client-clarification-draft.fallback: Refresh questions from the latest missing-information review.
client-clarification-draft.recovery: Refresh current project sources and continue unfinished useful work within the routine scope.

project-handoff.expected_when: The client brief and input review are current enough for Project Manager handoff.
project-handoff.acceptance: The structured handoff has all required fields and evidence paths.
project-handoff.fallback: Refresh the handoff from current project artifacts.
project-handoff.recovery: Refresh current project sources and continue unfinished useful work within the routine scope.

client-progress-update.expected_when: Current status or approved specialist output supports a client update.
client-progress-update.acceptance: The draft accurately covers completed work, open issues, blockers, and next actions.
client-progress-update.recovery: Refresh current project sources and continue unfinished useful work within the routine scope.

final-readiness-delivery.expected_when: Approved final readiness outputs are available for delivery.
final-readiness-delivery.acceptance: The draft lists verified approved outputs and states readiness preparation only.
final-readiness-delivery.fallback: Recheck output approval and prepare the local delivery draft.
final-readiness-delivery.recovery: Refresh current project sources and continue unfinished useful work within the routine scope.
